title: RAW RETURN HORIZON COMPARISON
hypothesis: 20/40/60 trading-session forward return horizons, under the same price-only predictor/control, produce different and measurable ranking stability.

data_scope.price: EXP-DATA-005 research price view; PRICE DATA = PASS FOR RESEARCH
data_scope.reason_for_end_date: 2025-06-01 onward remains descriptive-only under the common research contract

features.name: vol_63
features.formula: std of the last 63 valid close-to-close returns

model.preprocessing: training-only median imputation and z-score scaling

purge_rule: for each horizon, keep a training observation only when its actual label_end is strictly before validation/test start

horizon_selection.primary_statistic: median across inner folds of fold mean Rank IC
horizon_selection.tie_rule: if absolute difference is <= 0.01 choose the shorter horizon
horizon_selection.final_preference_rule: A horizon is PREFERRED only if selected in at least 3 of 4 outer folds and the selected-procedure outer mean Rank IC is positive, median fold Rank IC is non-negative, and positive-fold ratio is at least 0.5; otherwise NO CLEAR WINNER. Outer results may veto preference but may not choose a different horizon.
